test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

They said, "We enjoy watching cricket."

options.text: They said that they had enjoyed watching cricket.
They said that they have enjoyed watching cricket.
They said that they enjoy watching cricket.
They said that they enjoyed watching cricket.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they enjoyed watching cricket.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"We enjoy" becomes "they enjoyed"**
